content:
Just published my implementation of RealWorld (a reference full-stack web app) in Lean. It uses Lean both on the backend and the frontend.

Interactivity is achieved with datastar-lean (now an official Datastar Lean SDK I maintain with @Carlo Hamalainen )

See the repository + a link to the write-up on how it works here: https://github.com/saviorand/lean-realworld-example-app/
